Google's webpage details a multi-faceted approach to energy innovation, emphasizing **community empowerment**, **system modernization**, and **future-proofing** through renewable and advanced technologies. Key efforts include weatherizing homes, training workforces for AI-driven industries, and signing long-term agreements for 22 GW of clean energy. The company also leverages AI to optimize grid performance and explores next-generation solutions like small modular reactors (SMRs) and fusion energy.
